Since runs are successive gaps between 1s in the difference sequence, division by F(1)=2/5 rigorously yields all-order natural run frequencies. Exact-fraction program proves the stated 25 matrix entries by terminating rational computation; independent digit-extraction prefix agrees with the Toeplitz construction in 200000 positions. Finite tests are not presented as the infinite proof.
